method: Statically linked probes compiled from each candidate's DCC32 and DCUs; map-bounded normalized instruction matching, mapped direct-edge validation, and three RTTI/VMT-anchored TControl method checks.
limitations: Counts cover eligible reference blocks, not every instruction in each plugin.
Short or structurally identical routines can have multiple matching addresses.
Global data identities and untemplated/indirect callees are not fully validated.
Library matches identify supplied RTL/VCL builds; they do not independently prove the exact compiler executable or all application compiler switches.
A locally patched library reproducing the same code cannot be ruled out.
